column2: At last, the party infiltrated the $$教皇庁$$ in $$約束の地$$ $$ディアボロス$$,
and each was fatefully reunited with what they had been seeking.
But what they saw there was
a body cruelly impaled on a $$血$$-slick spear—
the corpse of the one they most $$愛$$d...
The Seven Virtues.
The rule of those bearing black $$羽$$.
The $$教団$$.
The armor of the $$大邪神$$.
Is the entire $$世界$$ now
about to face the Bible's foretold $$最後の審判$$?!
